# Third-party dependencies and licenses

This repository maintains third-party materials with the same separation of responsibility used in the ATAP-style project governance: TileO copyright and Community license are independent of upstream rights.

## Directory map

- [`DEPENDENCIES.md`](DEPENDENCIES.md) — **all 284 Clean 4 locked npm entries**, including direct/transitive/dev/optional packages, with a link to each per-package notice.
- [`MANIFEST.json`](MANIFEST.json) — machine-readable inventory and SHA-256 of every per-package notice.
- [`licenses/npm/`](licenses/npm/) — **284 collected license or notice texts**, separated by package/version.
- [`licenses/native/`](licenses/native/) — the Tippecanoe license set present in the supplied clean snapshot; native build closure remains release-specific.
- [`licenses/assets/`](licenses/assets/) — known Lucide/Feather attribution.
- [`reference/`](reference/) — source Clean 4 lockfile and combined generated notice corpus.
- [`NATIVE_COMPONENTS.md`](NATIVE_COMPONENTS.md) — native GIS, Node, OS and container considerations.
- [`ASSET_LICENSES.md`](ASSET_LICENSES.md) — icons, logos and geospatial-data provenance.
- [`LICENSE_COVERAGE.md`](LICENSE_COVERAGE.md) — what is and is not already evidenced.
- [`UPSTREAM_VERIFICATION.md`](UPSTREAM_VERIFICATION.md) — precise future verification workflow.
- [`RELEASE_GATE.md`](RELEASE_GATE.md) — binary release/Enterprise criteria.

**Important:** Some collected package license texts were generated by the Clean 4 notice generator as standard fallback license forms because their original LICENSE files were absent. These are retained as traceable references rather than represented as authenticated upstream copyright notices. For a distributed artifact, copy exact files from installed/package-tarball versions. The initial repository does not contain the application source or a distributable Docker image.
